sources: MDC GIS Area_Feature_Layers/FeatureServer/27 'Camping Sites' (1 point for this area) and /26 'Parking Lots' (21 lots), queried 2026-11-09
Esri World Imagery (leaf-off) 1.4 km and 240 m frames around 38.0416,-94.2721, viewed 2026-11-09
note: A 13,900-acre wetland complex on the Marais des Cygnes, Little Osage and Marmaton rivers: 14 managed marsh pools, bottomland forest and the Horton Bottoms Natural Area, run mainly for waterfowl and the managed duck hunt. The one designated camping spot is at a gravel lot with a privy beside the gravel road west of the Unit 2 pools. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites', one mapped camping spot at a gravel lot, free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. Pin sits ~45 m off the lot in a crop field - suggest moving it onto the lot. Not waterfront confirmed: the marsh pools are ~250 m east through woods.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Designated Camping Sites'; the map shows one camping symbol (with privy and ADA parking) beside the gravel road west of Pools 9-10, and GIS has a single 'Primitive Camping Area' point (38.04159,-94.27212). Imagery: a ~25 x 60 m gravel lot with a privy and a long shelter building off the gravel road, GIS lot 38.04127,-94.27176 (Paved, ADA 'Yes', Allows_Trailers 'No'). Drive-in on a maintained gravel road for a 23-ft rig; no ford.
PIN: the stored pin (the GIS point) falls ~45 m NW of the lot, in the edge of a crop field. Suggest moving it onto the gravel lot at about 38.04135,-94.27180.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront): confirmed. The managed marsh pools of Units 2/3 lie ~250 m east past a wooded strip and a levee road; a small farm pond ~160 m NW; no open water at the lot.

SEASON: the map's 'Waterfowl Refuge - closed to all uses Oct 15 - Mar 1' hatching covers Pools 10-11 just east of the camping lot; the camping symbol sits outside it, so the stored year-round season (manual, with its closure note) is left as stored.
Note rewritten: generic MDC text, acreage-only lead and the directions dropped.
